value.rationale: This gives a uniform genuine-equivariant suspension theorem for every finite nonempty graph and all inherited automorphism subgroups, yielding all subgroup geometric fixed-point homotopy types and integral representation modules. These invariants are not recoverable from nonequivariant sphere counts; the \(C_5\)-to-Grötzsch example provides a concrete natural application where a rotational fixed space becomes \(S^0\). The claim is structural rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
